review: Visual review of original frames sampled across all 38 seconds. First-bout open-mouth actions and smile negatives are development labels; prompts alone are not labels. Transition intervals omitted.
recording_limitation: MJPG changes pixels and classifier scores. Original capture probes confirm only one yawn; decoded baseline confirms two. This clip cannot validate recovery on original raw sensor pixels.
study_status: Same-person low-angle USB development. First bout split temporally for training/validation; correlated samples. Second bout excluded from training and checkpoint selection. New lossless live recapture and subject-held-out acceptance remain required.
